news.title: Patch Notes — v0.1.2
news.shortDescription: We've been reading your reviews and feedback since launch this update addresses the most reported issues along with a few small improvements. More to come.
news.fullBody:
We've been reading your reviews and feedback since launch, this update addresses the most reported issues along with a few small improvements. More to come.

BUG FIXES
- Fixed missing localization inputs
- Fixed several UI issues
- Fixed physics errors that caused certain traps to launch players at uncontrollable speeds
- Fixed bomb event synchronization issue between host and client
- Fixed a bug that occasionally prevented death on water contact

IMPROVEMENTS
- Improved level design
- Improved character controls — the balloon should now feel more responsive and fluid to navigate
- Improved physics system
- Improved overall UI experience
- Improved error detection: the game will now automatically detect out-of-bounds situations and return you to the nearest checkpoint
- Increased bomb size in the bomb event
- Various improvements for controller players
- Updated controller cursor

NEW LANGUAGES
- Added Malay
- Added Brazilian Portuguese

KNOWN ISSUES (we're actively working on these)
- Some visual effects may appear incorrectly
- Certain languages may display typos or incorrect text

Have a bug to report, a suggestion, or something you'd like to see in the game? Leave a review, use the in-game feedback button, or reach us on Discord. We read everything and do our best to make it happen.

— DWS Interactive

news.title: Guinea Pig Runaway Together Support Pack
news.shortDescription: Support the development and get exclusive in-game goodies with the Guinea Pig Runaway Together Support Pack.
news.fullBody:
Want to help us keep rolling?

The Guinea Pig Runaway Together Support Pack is now available. It includes exclusive cosmetic items and shows your support for an indie team of three working hard to make the best guinea pig co-op experience possible.

Every purchase goes directly back into development. Thank you for being part of this journey.

news.title: Vegawon's Legacy — Wishlist Now on Steam
news.shortDescription: A new adventure from DWS Interactive. Wishlist Vegawon's Legacy on Steam!
news.fullBody:
While we keep rolling with Guinea Pig Runaway Together, we also have something else brewing.

Vegawon's Legacy is a separate project from DWS Interactive. We are not going anywhere Guinea Pig Runaway Together development continues as planned.

If you are curious, head over to the Steam page and add it to your wishlist. It means a lot to us.
